description: Customer-voice research. Scrape comments and reviews from Reddit, YouTube, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, Trustpilot, app stores and 20+ other sources, search Reddit and YouTube, pull top-performing short videos with their hooks, find Meta Ad Library competitor ads, and build brand and voice-of-customer reports.
